issue.title: test_crashed_fakey_runner_frees_slot_without_done_marker hangs joining a released runner under the broad lane
issue.description:
Proposed by phase sase-1tc.5.1.2, note #5, and audited by sase-1tc.5.1.land. Node: tests/fakey/test_runner_slots_e2e.py::test_crashed_fakey_runner_frees_slot_without_done_marker.

Recorded check 203b10da45bc5567b16d396fbb323c64 on c756511c11 plus the owner-projection diff failed this node: timed out joining released crashed: started=True, released=True, thread_alive=True, errors=[]. The phase reports a subsequent isolated pass on the unchanged tree in notes #2/#6. Observed evidence is one broad-lane failure and one reported isolated pass; the long-run rate is unknown. The lander inspected the retained check failure and verified the phase implementation files against the recorded fingerprints; no runner-slot file changed in this epic. Evidence: file:explicit:d35dea9eedbf5dc21c83df1d.

Investigate the runner-slot fakey harness/process lifecycle and contention. Record fail/pass behavior under comparable load and find the mechanism before choosing a repair. Do not weaken assertions, add skips, or merely increase timeouts. Size large because the precise cause has not been established; this needs diagnosis and a plan.

Duplicate review: searched exact node, sibling node names, runner-slot variants, all task types/statuses, and the last-week task inventory. sase-n6 and sase-v0 track different sibling nodes and are being corroborated separately. sase-uw is a repaired deterministic process-identity contract regression, explicitly distinct from contention timeouts. No evidence causally ties this recurrence to active epic sase-1sl's capacity-scan optimization or sase-j7's process-global-state leaks; topic overlap is insufficient. Keep the node-specific scope until a common root cause is demonstrated.
